Metadata.title: Workaholics
Metadata.description: A community where makers show their work and get honest feedback.

Home.title: Workaholics
Home.tagline: Build things. Share them. Help each other.

Health.title: Platform status
Health.unreachable: The platform can't be reached. Try again later.

PublicBadge.publicTitle: Everyone can see this, not only members

State.unreachableTitle: We can't reach the Workaholics platform right now
State.unreachableBody: The site is up but data isn't coming through. Anything you typed stays on this page; send it again once the connection is back.
State.errorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a few minutes; if it still fails, send us this code.

Auth.signInHint: You sign in with your Telegram account; there is no password.
Auth.inviteHint: The code the member who invited you sent you.
Auth.notMember: Not a member yet? Membership is by invitation.
Auth.welcome: Welcome! Complete your handle and bio so others know who you are.

Errors.invite_required: You need an invite code to join. If you are already a member, sign in with the Telegram account you joined with.
Errors.invite_invalid: This invite code is not valid or has already been used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
Errors.invite_expired: This invite code has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
Errors.telegram_signature_invalid: Telegram sign-in could not be verified. Please try again.
Errors.sign_in_failed: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
Errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a little while.
Errors.session_required: Please sign in again to continue.
Errors.unreachable: We can't reach the server right now. Please try again shortly.
Errors.validation_failed: Some fields are not filled in correctly.
Errors.not_project_owner: Only the project's owners can do this.
Errors.last_owner: A project needs at least one owner.
Errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
Errors.notFoundBody: The address may be wrong, or the page was removed.
Errors.own_project: You can't give feedback on your own project.
Errors.not_author: Only the author can edit this.
Errors.reply_not_allowed: Only the person who gave the feedback and the project's owners can reply here.
Errors.not_current_response: This is no longer the current answer. Reload the page.
Errors.recheck_required: For “Test it”, say when you'll report back.
Errors.acted_on_invalid: You can only pick answered feedback on this project.

errors.handlePattern: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and _ only, starting with a letter.
errors.slugPattern: Lowercase Latin letters and digits only, with hyphens between words.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a full address that starts with http or https.
errors.linkIncomplete: Fill in both the label and the address.
errors.slugTaken: This project address is not available.
errors.dateInvalid: Pick a date from tomorrow up to six months ahead.
errors.reasonRequired: Write the reason. An answer without a reason isn't saved.

Links.hint: Up to {max, number} links, such as a website or a code repository.
Links.label: Link {n, number} label

Profile.handleHint: It appears in your page's address.
Profile.bioHint: What are you building, and what feedback are you looking for?
Profile.noScores: There are no followers or scores here, only work and feedback.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.name: Project name
Projects.slugHint: It is used in the project page's address and cannot be changed later.
Projects.ownersHint: Every owner can edit the project and add or remove other owners.
Projects.onlyOwners: Only the project's owners can edit it.
Projects.timelineEmpty: There are no posts on this project yet.
Projects.timelineEmptyOwner: Write the first post: show your work in progress and say what feedback you want.

Posts.kindWipHint: Show unfinished work and ask for the feedback you want.
Posts.kindUpdateHint: Say what you did with the feedback.
Posts.question: Question {n, number}
Posts.questionsHint: At least one question, at most five. People giving feedback answer these.
Posts.selfCritiqueHint: Where do you think the work is weak?
Posts.whatChangedHint: What have you done since the last post?
Posts.actedOnHint: The answered feedback these changes came from.
Posts.actedOnEmpty: There is no answered feedback on this project yet.
Posts.oneNumberHint: One sentence with one number, in your own words, for example “3 of 5 people finished sign-up”.
Posts.onlyOwners: Only the project's owners post here.
Posts.editClosed: This post can no longer be edited: the 15-minute window has closed.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.order: Awaiting ones first, then in time order
Feedback.emptyAnswered: No feedback has been answered yet.
Feedback.composerHint: Say specifically what you saw and what you suggest. The owner answers it: accepts it, rejects it or tests it.
Feedback.goodBody: Answer the post's questions, point at one specific thing, and say why.
Feedback.ruleBody: Answer every piece of feedback within 7 days: accept, reject or test it, always with a reason. After 7 days, how long it has been overdue shows next to it.
Feedback.savedFeedback: Your feedback is in. The project's owners will be notified.
Feedback.savedAnswer: Answer saved. <n>{name}</n> will be notified and can reply.
Feedback.givenEmptySelf: You haven't given any feedback yet.

Answer.acceptedMeaning: It's right, and you'll act on it.
Answer.rejectedMeaning: You won't act on it, and you say why.
Answer.testingMeaning: You don't know yet; you'll test it and report back by the date you set.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.reply_received: <n>{actor}</n> replied in a feedback thread on <n>{project}</n>.
Notifications.response_due: Feedback on <n>{project}</n> has waited five days for your answer.
Notifications.telegramBody: To get these notifications and the weekly summary in Telegram, open the Workaholics bot and press Start. Send /stop any time to turn it off.
Notifications.telegramOn: These notifications also go to your Telegram. Send /stop to the bot to turn that off.

Awaiting.title: Awaiting my answer
Awaiting.intro: Feedback on your projects that hasn't been answered yet, oldest first.
Awaiting.empty: No feedback is waiting for your answer.
